summary: The Fairbanks court sat on Saturday afternoon, Nov. 7, and opened six criminal files, five of them dated that day. Two carry a felony: a Class B felony assault with a weapon against Harlen Lee Captain, offense-dated Nov. 7, and a Class C felony assault against Terrance Mouton over a Nov. 6 disturbance at a Fairbanks hotel, a count the arrest report did not carry. Four of the six files include a count the court records as domestic violence related, while the Lakeview Terrace arrest troopers described as a domestic disturbance was charged with no assault count and no domestic violence flag. Alaska State Troopers reported eight incidents in the Fairbanks area on Nov. 6 and one early on Nov. 7, and a Delta Junction jury acquitted a man of four felony counts of sexual abuse of a minor on Nov. 6. The filing counts below are the Alaska Court System weekly charges report's own counts for its window of Oct. 31 to Nov. 6; that report was last run at 9 p.m. on Nov. 6 and does not include the six cases opened since, nor Fairbanks case 4FA-26-02247CR.

entries.title: Felony assault charge: Harlen Lee Captain
body: Harlen Lee Captain is charged with assault in the second degree — intentionally causing injury with a dangerous instrument — a Class B felony, punishable by up to ten years. He is also charged with criminal mischief in the fifth degree, damaging property worth less than $250, a Class B misdemeanor. The court record lists both counts as domestic violence related and gives an offense date of Nov. 7 at Fairbanks.
The case was filed at Fairbanks on Nov. 7 and he was arraigned the same afternoon. Counsel was appointed from the bench and release conditions were set.
Case 4FA-26-02245CR; preliminary hearing Nov. 17.

entries.title: Felony assault charge: Terrance Mouton
body: Terrance Mouton is charged with assault in the third degree — placing another person in fear of injury by means of a dangerous instrument — a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. He is also charged with assault in the fourth degree, recklessly injuring another person, a Class A misdemeanor, and criminal mischief in the fifth degree, damaging property worth less than $250, a Class B misdemeanor. The court record lists all three counts as domestic violence related.

Troopers say they received a report of a disturbance at the La Quinta Inn in Fairbanks at about 9:37 p.m. on Nov. 6 and that an assault had taken place. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center. Troopers reported the arrest as assault in the fourth degree and criminal mischief in the fifth degree; the felony count was filed by the district attorney.
Case 4FA-26-02242CR; arraigned Nov. 7, preliminary hearing Nov. 17.

entries.title: Assault charge: David Titus Peter
body: David Titus Peter is charged with assault in the fourth degree — placing another person in fear of imminent injury — a Class A misdemeanor. The court record lists the count as domestic violence related and gives an offense date of Nov. 7 at Fairbanks.
The case was filed at Fairbanks on Nov. 7 and he was arraigned the same afternoon. Counsel was appointed from the bench and release conditions were set.
Case 4FA-26-02246CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 24.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Elaina Deborah Carroll
body: Elaina Deborah Carroll, 20, was arrested on a charge of assault in the fourth degree — recklessly injuring another person — a Class A misdemeanor. 300 block of Wedgewood Drive, Fairbanks, Nov. 6 at 11:52 p.m.; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26003393.
The court filed the charge at Fairbanks on Nov. 7 and lists it as domestic violence related.
Case 4FA-26-02244CR; arraignment Nov. 8.

entries.title: Release violation count added: Maya Jade Newman
body: A third count was added on Nov. 7 to an open Fairbanks case against Maya Jade Newman: violating conditions of release on a misdemeanor charge — breaking a condition a court set on release — a Class B misdemeanor, with an offense date of Nov. 6. She was arraigned on the new count the same afternoon.

The two existing counts, both listed as domestic violence related, are assault in the fourth degree by placing another person in fear of imminent injury, a Class A misdemeanor, and unlawful contact in the second degree, a Class B misdemeanor, both with an offense date of Oct. 29.
Case 4FA-26-02199CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 24.

entries.title: Unlawful contact and release violation charges: Dustin Walters
body: Dustin Walters is charged with unlawful contact — contacting a person a parole condition forbids contacting — a Class A misdemeanor, and with violating conditions of release on a misdemeanor charge, breaking a condition a court set on release, a Class B misdemeanor. Neither count is listed as domestic violence related on the court record.

Troopers say they responded to a residence on Lakeview Terrace in Fairbanks on Nov. 6 for a report of a domestic disturbance, that Walters was on house arrest at the time, and that he was arrested for assault in the fourth degree, unlawful contact, two counts of assault in the presence of a child and violating conditions of release. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center. No assault count was filed in the case.
Case 4FA-26-02243CR; arraigned Nov. 7, pre-trial conference Dec. 24.

entries.title: Driving while license revoked arrest: Allen Broeke
body: Allen Broeke is charged with driving while his license was canceled, revoked or suspended for a criminal offense, a Class A misdemeanor.

Troopers say he was stopped on the Richardson Highway near the Department of Transportation scales at North Pole at about 10:49 a.m. on Nov. 6 after being observed speeding, and that a records check showed his license revoked and a prior conviction for the same offense in November 2024.
Case 4FA-26-02247CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Acquittal: Andrew Rihel
body: A jury at the Delta Junction courthouse returned a verdict on Nov. 6 and the court entered a judgment of acquittal in the case against Andrew Rihel, who was charged with two counts of sexual abuse of a minor in the first degree, an unclassified felony, and two counts of sexual abuse of a minor in the second degree, a Class B felony. No count on the file carries a conviction.

The charges were returned by a grand jury and all four were dated Jan. 30, 2023, with an offense location of Delta Junction. The trial sat on Nov. 3, Nov. 4 and Nov. 5 before the verdict on Nov. 6; one of those days was heard at the Fairbanks courthouse and the rest at Delta Junction.
Case 4DJ-24-00006CR, before Judge Brent Bennett. No further hearing is set.

entries.title: Arrest warrant ordered: Jennifer Morgan Lofrano
body: Jennifer Morgan Lofrano did not appear for her arraignment at the Fairbanks courthouse at 8:30 a.m. on Nov. 6, and the court record shows a warrant ordered to issue.
The case was opened on Oct. 31 at Fairbanks. The court file records a single count as a charging document pending or not filed, so no charge and no charge class is stated on it.
Case 4FA-26-02207CR. No further hearing is set.

entries.title: Murder case status hearing held: Cedar Mae Sarten
body: A status hearing in the case against Cedar Mae Sarten was held at 9 a.m. on Nov. 6 in Fairbanks Superior Court before Judge Brent Bennett, and the court entered a transport order the same day.

A Fairbanks jury found Sarten guilty in May of murder in the first degree in the death of her five-year-old son. A sentencing date that had been calendared for Nov. 6 is recorded as reset; sentencing stands at Jan. 29, 2027.
Case 4FA-24-02118CR.

entries.title: Release order in burglary case: Trenton Allen Rix
body: The court entered a temporary order of conditions of release on Nov. 6 in the case against Trenton Allen Rix, who is charged with burglary in the first degree — an unlawful entry in which someone is injured or injury is attempted — a Class B felony, punishable by up to 10 years.

He is also charged with theft in the fourth degree and with violating the conditions of release on a felony case. The prosecutor had applied for bail review and a bail hearing was calendared for 9:15 a.m. on Nov. 6; the court record shows no result against that hearing.
Case 4FA-26-02223CR. His next court date is Nov. 12.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Chantz Chandler
body: Chantz Chandler, 20, was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence — operating a vehicle while impaired by alcohol or drugs.

Troopers say they stopped a vehicle traveling 64 mph in a posted 45 mph zone on Geist Road in Fairbanks at about 3:37 a.m. on Nov. 6, that the driver showed signs of impairment, and that he later gave a breath sample of .152. They say he was also cited for consumption of alcohol by a person under 21. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02238CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Criminal trespass arrest: John Franklin Erlich Jr.
body: John Franklin Erlich Jr. was arrested on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully upon premises.

Troopers say they responded to a report of a possible burglary in progress off Lake View Terrace in Fairbanks at about 6:21 a.m. on Nov. 6 and contacted a man matching the description on the premises of the reported residence. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02239CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Amber Serenity Brahma
body: Amber Serenity Brahma, 33, was arrested on a charge of assault in the fourth degree — causing fear of imminent injury — recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
100 block of Lacey Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 6; Fairbanks Police. Police case 25003838.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Sanna Naomi Nell Hein
body: Sanna Naomi Nell Hein, 31, was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
100 block of Lacey Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 6; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26002808.

entries.title: Cell phone reported stolen in Fairbanks
body: A cell phone was reported stolen in the area of Lakeview Terrace in Fairbanks on Nov. 6. Troopers say no suspect has been identified and the case is ongoing.

entries.title: Unlawful contact and release violations: Thomas James Madison Grover
body: Thomas James Madison Grover is charged with unlawful contact — contacting a person a court order forbids him from contacting — a Class A misdemeanor recorded by the court as domestic violence related, and with two counts of violating conditions of release for a misdemeanor, each a Class B misdemeanor.
The offenses are dated Nov. 5 at Fairbanks. He was arraigned Nov. 6 and counsel was appointed.
Case 4FA-26-02240CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 10.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Joshua Thomas Slagle
body: Joshua Thomas Slagle, 41, was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, recorded by police as a misdemeanor.

100 block of College Road, Fairbanks, Nov. 5 at 8:35 p.m.; Fairbanks Police. An incident of possession of other drugs is recorded on the same police case number at the same block about half an hour earlier.
Case 4FA-26-02236CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Criminal case opened with no charging document: David Heater
body: A criminal case was opened against David Heater at Fairbanks on Nov. 6, with an offense date of Nov. 6. The court file records the charge as a charging document pending or not filed, so no charge and no charge class is stated on it. He was released on standard conditions.
Case 4FA-26-02237CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: DUI arrest after College Road collision
body: Troopers say they responded to a reported motor vehicle collision on College Road in Fairbanks on Nov. 5 that resulted in an arrest for driving under the influence. No name has been released and troopers say the investigation is ongoing.

entries.title: Utility trailer reported stolen at North Pole
body: A dual-axle utility trailer was reported stolen from a property at North Pole at about 10:50 a.m. on Nov. 5. Troopers say there are no suspects or leads and that the trailer was placed in stolen status.

entries.title: Shoplifting reported in Fairbanks
body: A shoplifting was reported at the 900 block of Old Steese Highway in Fairbanks at about 5:22 p.m. on Nov. 5; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26003381.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Corinna Lucille Sheri Gray
body: Corinna Lucille Sheri Gray, 35, was arrested on a charge of assault in the fourth degree — recklessly injuring another person — recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
100 block of Lacey Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 4; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26002692.

entries.title: Criminal trespass charge: Rachel Renee Hancock
body: Rachel Renee Hancock, 26, of Healy is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully upon premises — a Class B misdemeanor.
Troopers say they received a report of trespassing at a Healy gas station on Oct. 30, could not locate her that day, and issued her a misdemeanor summons on Nov. 4.
Case 4NE-26-00109CR; arraignment Nov. 16 at the Nenana courthouse.

entries.title: DUI charges: Chad James De Long
body: Chad James De Long is charged with driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, with refusing to submit to a chemical test, and with driving while his license was canceled, revoked or suspended for a criminal offense. Each count is a Class A misdemeanor on the court file.
The offenses are dated Oct. 31 at Delta Junction. He was arraigned Nov. 1 and a cash performance bond was posted Nov. 3.
Case 4DJ-26-00069CR; rural calendar call Dec. 15 at the Delta Junction courthouse.
